# Cloudflare Browser CDP

> A Cloudflare Worker that exposes headless Chrome via the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) over WebSocket. Connect via WebSocket with a shared secret to control a remote browser for automation, scraping, screenshots, and testing.

Key facts:

- Requires Cloudflare Workers Paid plan ($5/month) for Browser Rendering
- Authentication via `?secret=<CDP_SECRET>` query parameter on all endpoints
- WebSocket connection at `wss://<worker-url>?secret=<CDP_SECRET>`
- Send CDP commands as JSON: `{"id": 1, "method": "Domain.method", "params": {...}}`
- Responses are JSON: `{"id": 1, "result": {...}}` or `{"id": 1, "error": {"code": -32000, "message": "..."}}`
- Events are JSON without id: `{"method": "Event.name", "params": {...}}`

## Connecting

WebSocket connection example:

```javascript
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://your-worker.workers.dev?secret=YOUR_SECRET');

ws.onopen = () => {
  ws.send(JSON.stringify({ id: 1, method: 'Page.navigate', params: { url: 'https://example.com' } }));
};

ws.onmessage = (event) => {
  const response = JSON.parse(event.data);
  // Initial connection sends Target.targetCreated event with targetId
  // Use targetId in params for multi-tab scenarios
};
```

## Supported CDP Methods

Browser domain:
- `Browser.getVersion` - Returns browser version info
- `Browser.close` - Closes the browser session

Target domain:
- `Target.createTarget` - Create new page: `{url?: string}` → `{targetId}`
- `Target.closeTarget` - Close page: `{targetId}` → `{success: true}`
- `Target.getTargets` - List pages → `{targetInfos: [{targetId, type, title, url}]}`
- `Target.attachToTarget` - Attach to target: `{targetId}` → `{sessionId}`

Page domain:
- `Page.navigate` - Navigate: `{url}` → `{frameId, loaderId}`
- `Page.reload` - Reload current page
- `Page.captureScreenshot` - Screenshot: `{format?: 'png'|'jpeg'|'webp', quality?: number, clip?: {x,y,width,height}, fullPage?: boolean}` → `{data}` (base64)
- `Page.printToPDF` - Generate PDF: `{landscape?, printBackground?, scale?, paperWidth?, paperHeight?, margin*?}` → `{data}` (base64)
- `Page.setContent` - Set HTML: `{html, waitUntil?: 'load'|'domcontentloaded'|'networkidle0'|'networkidle2'}`
- `Page.getFrameTree` - Get frame structure
- `Page.getLayoutMetrics` - Get viewport/content dimensions
- `Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument` - Inject script: `{source}` → `{identifier}`
- `Page.handleJavaScriptDialog` - Handle dialogs: `{accept, promptText?}`
- `Page.stopLoading` - Stop page load
- `Page.getNavigationHistory` - Get history entries
- `Page.navigateToHistoryEntry` - Navigate history: `{entryId}`
- `Page.setBypassCSP` - Bypass CSP: `{enabled}`

Runtime domain:
- `Runtime.evaluate` - Execute JS: `{expression, returnByValue?: true, awaitPromise?: false}` → `{result: {type, value, objectId?}}` or `{exceptionDetails}`
- `Runtime.callFunctionOn` - Call function: `{functionDeclaration, arguments?: [{value}|{objectId}], returnByValue?}`
- `Runtime.getProperties` - Get object props: `{objectId, ownProperties?}` → `{result: [{name, value}]}`
- `Runtime.releaseObject` - Release ref: `{objectId}`
- `Runtime.releaseObjectGroup` - Release all refs

DOM domain:
- `DOM.getDocument` - Get document: `{depth?}` → `{root: {nodeId, ...}}`
- `DOM.querySelector` - Find element: `{nodeId, selector}` → `{nodeId}` (0 if not found)
- `DOM.querySelectorAll` - Find all: `{nodeId, selector}` → `{nodeIds}`
- `DOM.getOuterHTML` - Get HTML: `{nodeId}` → `{outerHTML}`
- `DOM.getAttributes` - Get attrs: `{nodeId}` → `{attributes: [name, value, ...]}`
- `DOM.setAttributeValue` - Set attr: `{nodeId, name, value}`
- `DOM.focus` - Focus element: `{nodeId}`
- `DOM.getBoxModel` - Get dimensions: `{nodeId}` → `{model: {content, padding, border, margin}}`
- `DOM.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded` - Scroll to element: `{nodeId}`
- `DOM.removeNode` - Remove element: `{nodeId}`
- `DOM.setNodeValue` - Set text: `{nodeId, value}`
- `DOM.setFileInputFiles` - Set file input: `{nodeId, files: [path, ...]}`

Input domain:
- `Input.dispatchMouseEvent` - Mouse: `{type: 'mousePressed'|'mouseReleased'|'mouseMoved'|'mouseWheel', x, y, button?, clickCount?, deltaX?, deltaY?}`
- `Input.dispatchKeyEvent` - Keyboard: `{type: 'keyDown'|'keyUp'|'char', key?, text?}`
- `Input.insertText` - Type text: `{text}`

Network domain:
- `Network.setCacheDisabled` - Disable cache: `{cacheDisabled}`
- `Network.setExtraHTTPHeaders` - Set headers: `{headers: {name: value}}`
- `Network.setCookie` - Set cookie: `{name, value, url?, domain?, path?, secure?, httpOnly?, sameSite?, expires?}`
- `Network.setCookies` - Set multiple: `{cookies: [...]}`
- `Network.getCookies` - Get cookies: `{urls?}` → `{cookies}`
- `Network.deleteCookies` - Delete: `{name, url?, domain?, path?}`
- `Network.clearBrowserCookies` - Clear all cookies
- `Network.setUserAgentOverride` - Set UA: `{userAgent}`

Emulation domain:
- `Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride` - Set viewport: `{width, height, deviceScaleFactor?, mobile?}`
- `Emulation.clearDeviceMetricsOverride` - Reset to 1280x720
- `Emulation.setUserAgentOverride` - Set UA: `{userAgent}`
- `Emulation.setGeolocationOverride` - Set location: `{latitude, longitude, accuracy?}`
- `Emulation.clearGeolocationOverride` - Clear location
- `Emulation.setTimezoneOverride` - Set timezone: `{timezoneId}`
- `Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled` - Enable touch: `{enabled}`
- `Emulation.setEmulatedMedia` - Set media: `{media?, features?: [{name, value}]}`

Fetch domain (request interception):
- `Fetch.enable` - Enable interception: `{patterns?: [{urlPattern?, requestStage?}]}`
- `Fetch.disable` - Disable interception
- `Fetch.continueRequest` - Continue: `{requestId, url?, method?, postData?, headers?: [{name, value}]}`
- `Fetch.fulfillRequest` - Mock response: `{requestId, responseCode, responseHeaders?: [{name, value}], body?}` (body is base64)
- `Fetch.failRequest` - Fail request: `{requestId, errorReason}`

## Common Patterns

Take a screenshot:
```javascript
await send('Page.navigate', { url: 'https://example.com' });
await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 3000)); // wait for load
const { data } = await send('Page.captureScreenshot', { format: 'png' });
const buffer = Buffer.from(data, 'base64');
```

Evaluate JavaScript:
```javascript
const { result } = await send('Runtime.evaluate', { expression: 'document.title' });
console.log(result.value); // page title
```

Click an element:
```javascript
const { root } = await send('DOM.getDocument');
const { nodeId } = await send('DOM.querySelector', { nodeId: root.nodeId, selector: 'button.submit' });
const { model } = await send('DOM.getBoxModel', { nodeId });
const x = (model.content[0] + model.content[2]) / 2;
const y = (model.content[1] + model.content[5]) / 2;
await send('Input.dispatchMouseEvent', { type: 'mousePressed', x, y, button: 'left', clickCount: 1 });
await send('Input.dispatchMouseEvent', { type: 'mouseReleased', x, y, button: 'left' });
```

Set viewport for mobile:
```javascript
await send('Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride', { width: 375, height: 812, deviceScaleFactor: 2, mobile: true });
await send('Network.setUserAgentOverride', { userAgent: 'Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 14_0 like Mac OS X)...' });
```

## Optional

- [Chrome DevTools Protocol Documentation](https://chromedevtools.github.io/devtools-protocol/): Full CDP reference (this worker implements a subset)
- [Puppeteer Documentation](https://pptr.dev/): The underlying browser automation library
